positive: A UI or copy system must survive English/Spanish expansion, locale formatting, bidi, or locale-native voice.
negative: The request is only English copy polish or a non-locale accessibility defect.

exclusions: Do not translate word-for-word when locale-native meaning is required.
Do not use fixed widths or concatenated strings that fail expansion or bidi.
stop_conditions: Stop when supported locales or source meaning are undefined.
Hand off general accessibility defects to a11y-pass and voice rewriting to humanize-copy.
